hooks.command: echo "SPIKE559-SH cwd=$(pwd) v=$(cat "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/SPIKE_VERSION") node=$(command -v node || echo ABSENT) git=$(command -v git || echo ABSENT) sh=$0 envfile=${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-UNSET}"; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ]; then echo 'export NB_SPIKE_ENV=reached' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'agent-notebook: Node.js is not installed, so the notebook is off. Tell the user: install Node.js LTS from https://nodejs.org, then quit and reopen the app.'

Write-Output ('SPIKE559-PS cwd=' + (Get-Location).Path + ' ps=' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion + ' edition=' + $PSVersionTable.PSEdition + ' node=' + [string](Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source + ' git=' + [string](Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source + ' envfile=' + [string]$env:CLAUDE_ENV_FILE + ' root=' + $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT)

if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output 'agent-notebook: Node.js is not installed, so the notebook is off. Tell the user: install Node.js LTS from https://nodejs.org, then quit and reopen the app.' }

args: case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) exit 0;; esac; node -e "process.exit(+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]<18?1:0)" 2>/dev/null || echo 'EXEC-SH agent-notebook: Node.js 18 or later is needed; it is missing or too old here, so the notebook is off. Tell the user: install Node.js LTS from https://nodejs.org, then quit and reopen the app.'

if (-not $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $ok = $false } else { node -e "process.exit(+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]<18?1:0)"; $ok = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) }; if (-not $ok) { Write-Output 'EXEC-PS agent-notebook: Node.js 18 or later is needed; it is missing or too old here, so the notebook is off. Tell the user: install Node.js LTS from https://nodejs.org, then quit and reopen the app.' }
